notes.title: Enigma Awaken Demo End
notes.content:
I know a lot of you wanted to test the game right now but the demo was not a complete success because I used a special version for it instead of using the one of the actual maps form the game for that I apologize, but we will come back later to give you a more advanced version with one of the actual mission in the game and a more optimized version of the game.

Thank you all for the feedback, good or bad, it was all very helpful and I do appreciate.

With love,
SGD

notes.title: Important information
notes.content:
Now that I know what problems players are facing there will be a lot of fixes, this is why we test and ask for feedback, so that you can help us make the game better.

Now the map, AI, Assets, and almost everything is still in development stage, so please bear with me as this is the first time i launch a demo, the game will be developed and worked on much more and as the Steam fest finishes the demo will be on hold until the game is fully ready without any bugs or problems.

Thank you all,
Sincerely Sam

notes.title: October Fest is hereeeeeee
notes.content:
Steam fest is here, and we are doing goood, but we need your help with feedback, the more feedback you provide the better we do in the future.

PS: if you are having low FPS don't worry, the game will be optimized and the performance will become much much better

notes.title: Sound Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We've received feedback from some demo users regarding audio issues in the game. This was an unexpected oversight and has now been resolved. A small notice has been added to the main menu to guide players who may encounter any sound issues.

If you experience any absence of sound, simply navigate to the game’s audio settings, ensure that the sound is set to "On," and adjust the volume to your preference (between 0 and 100).

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: We are making the Enigma better
notes.content:
After over a year of work on Enigma Awaken, I have discovered that it might need a bit of more work, the original launch date was supposed to be 15/09/2024 but I decided to give you more than expected, so there will be more stuff added to the game, I'm planing to launch AA game in the price of an indie game.

This will be very difficult since I'm a solo dev, but I will not stop until I do, and Enigma awaken will not be the end, there will be more and more after it.

The demo will launch soon, and the Full game if all goes well will launch within 2 to 3 months hopefully before the end of the year

notes.title: Enigma Awaken Demo News
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

The Enigma Awaken free demo will soon be ready to be published for all of you to enjoy.

Planning 2 demo releases for public testing, first release in September and the second in October, with your feedback we can improve the game to be the best indie game ever.
